title: Root disk full from unrotated debug logs
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the web/API component, the disk‑full problem, and the new collect-debug-logs cron job as the trigger.
root_cause: The newly added collect-debug-logs cron job continuously appended large debug dumps to /var/log/shop/debug.log, filling the root filesystem until it was 97% full and preventing the API container from writing logs, which caused 500 errors on dynamic product pages.
truth: A new cron job 'collect-debug-logs' was added two days ago. It writes verbose debug output to /var/log/shop/debug.log but the logrotate config was not updated for this file, so the log grows unbounded. The root disk (/) reached 97% used, leaving no space for nginx to write its access log or for the api container to write its log, causing 500 errors on all dynamic requests.
